business_objective: Coordinate supervised counter viewing of available service records and close each request after the resident acknowledges completion.

stakeholder_statements.text: A resident submits a counter-viewing request and identifies the service record and viewing purpose.
The service clerk records whether the service record is available for counter viewing.
The records custodian records the service record as prepared for viewing.
The viewing officer records the viewing session as started. The resident records acknowledgement when the viewing is complete.
The records supervisor closes the viewing request only after record preparation and resident acknowledgement are recorded. Providing copies and changing the service record are outside this project.

business_objective: Review workspace-seat reclaim requests and return approved seats from inactive, unprotected members to the available seat pool.

stakeholder_statements.text: A workspace owner submits a seat-reclaim request and identifies the workspace and member whose seat is under review.
The activity reviewer records the member as active or inactive. The activity criteria have not been agreed.
The access steward records whether the member holds a protected role that blocks seat reclaim. The protected-role categories are not finalized.
The subscription operations clerk records the request as approved or returned and adds a reason when it is returned. The approval criteria are undecided.

The seat records officer returns the seat to the available pool only after inactive status, no protected-role block, and approval are recorded, then sends the outcome to the workspace owner. The delivery channel is undecided. Purchasing additional seats and deleting member data are outside this project.

business_objective: Review corrections to recorded preparation-batch yields and replace supported yields for usable batches.

stakeholder_statements.text: A kitchen lead submits a prep-yield correction and identifies the preparation batch, recorded yield, and observed yield.
The prep records clerk records supporting evidence for the correction. The accepted evidence types have not been agreed.
The inventory analyst records whether the proposed yield aligns with the ingredient quantity issued to the batch. The alignment criteria are undecided.
The food safety reviewer records the batch as usable or held. The usability criteria are not finalized.

The portion records clerk replaces the recorded yield only after inventory alignment and usable status are recorded, then sends the outcome to the kitchen lead. The delivery channel is undecided. Changing the recipe and physically disposing of food are outside this project.

business_objective: Review shipments with missing documents while preserving an unresolved rule about conditional release when the missing document is classified as non-critical.

stakeholder_statements.text: A consignment coordinator submits a document-gap release review and identifies the shipment and missing document.
The document examiner records the missing-document category and supporting evidence. The categories and accepted evidence types are not finalized.
The compliance officer records a compliance assessment. The officer says the shipment must remain held until every required document is accepted.
The operations planner records the continuity impact. The planner says the shipment may be released when the missing document is non-critical and a follow-up record is created.

The release controller records the shipment as released or held after the document category, compliance assessment, and continuity impact are present, then sends the outcome to the consignment coordinator. Nobody has decided which release rule controls, who resolves the disagreement, what the follow-up record must contain, which delivery channel to use, or the maximum decision time. Filing customs declarations and physically transporting the shipment are outside this project; the meeting also drifted into complaints about the loading-bay lights.
